BiblicalUsage: Jidlaph is a Mesopotamian, a son of Nahor. In Genesis 22:22, Jidlaph, and Bethuel.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Jidlaph matters because God works through ordinary people, and no name in His book is there by accident.
